forecast-period.text: A cold front slips across the southeast of the state overnight into Monday, as a high pressure system moves into the Bight, behind the front. The high is forecast to extend a ridge throughout the state as it moves east during the week, likely being centred over NSW towards the end of the week.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Patchy morning frost and fog about parts of the Northern Agricultural Area and southern parts of the Pastoral districts. Isolated showers about the southeast, clearing from the evening. Maximum temperatures near to below average. Southwest to southeasterly winds, tending north to northeasterly in the west from the evening.

Isolated showers continuing about parts of the Southern Agricultural Areas and the southeast. North to northwesterly winds ahead of a west to southwesterly change moving into southeast parts of the state. Winds shifting south to southeasterly winds in the north and west throughout the night.

Possible patchy morning frost or fog about parts of the Agricultural Areas and southern parts of the Pastoral districts. Mostly dry, chance of an isolated light shower about the Eyre and Yorke Peninsulas. Maximum temperatures near to below average, tending near to above average in the west. Northeast to southeasterly winds, tending southwesterly in the southeast until the evening.

Possible morning fog on and east of the ranges and morning frost about parts of the central and eastern districts. Mostly dry, chance of an isolated shower in the far west. Maximum temperatures near average. Northwest to northeasterly winds, shifting northeast to southeasterly during the day.

text.p: Possible patchy morning frost about the Riverland and central districts. Mostly dry. Maximum temperatures near to above average. North to northeasterly winds.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Thursday: Less than 2 mm about the Agricultural Areas, tending 2-5 mm about coastal parts and inland parts of the west. Isolated falls between 5 to 15 mm possible about windward facing coasts and ranges and in the South East.
